### Function calls

```{r, results = "asis"}
call_fits <- Filter(function(fit) inherits(fit, "tam_fit"), fits)
calls <- lapply(call_fits, `[[`, "call")
if (length(calls)) {
  calls_parsed <- sapply(calls, deparse1, width.cutoff = 50L, collapse = "\n")
  calls_html <- paste("<pre style='margin:0; white-space:pre-wrap'>\n",
                      htmltools::htmlEscape(calls_parsed),
                      "\n</pre>")
  calls_df <- data.frame(Model = htmltools::htmlEscape(names(calls)), Call = calls_html)
  cat('<div style="height: 100%; overflow-y: auto;">\n\n')
  print(knitr::kable(calls_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE, col.names = NULL))
  cat('\n</div>\n\n')
}
```
